title: Metric completion need not preserve minimal Sobolev gradients
established: A doubling metric measure space supporting a Poincar\'e inequality has a function with source minimal gradient at most $1$ and completion gradient $\sqrt2$. The completion complement is nonmeasurable.
scope_or_remaining: The conclusion concerns exactly the catalogue target; no historical priority claim is made.
author: Matthew J. Colbrook
outcome: Counterexample: minimal Sobolev gradients need not be preserved by completion.
